title: The Crooked Ember Revisited
author: Kestrel Lockridge
blurb: Jude Delacroix, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
